column1: # Hand verdicts for sources/measure.mjs (written for hoshidicts, GPL-3.0-or-later). A key is a word whose first result with a
# definition (kty-ko-en as published, references followed) is its own entry, or word>lemma for a lemma its references name
# shown first for a word that splits as a noun or pronoun + particle, whose references name two or more lemmas, or for which
# the pack has a whole-word rule to another lemma. Judged: every such word with 100 tokens or more among the 10,000 most
# frequent words of ko_50k, or 2 positions or more in Tatoeba. OK: right (for an own entry, its first sense is the word's use);
# M: an own entry whose first sense is not the use, which comes further down or is one of the word's split uses; C: right or
# wrong by context; W: wrong (the card has no sense of the use, or the lemma is another word).
